text:
maya.pm: Quick sync — we need a tight plan for a segmented private-pilot (10 customers) that tests onboarding + telemetry + rollback behavior. goal is to validate the private deployment flow and gather behavioural signals for infra optimizations. suggestions?
ethan.eng: +1. want to lock the integration checklist before outreach. last time a missing env var slowed two customers.
lena.design: recommend two recruiting lanes: 1) integration-first (platform teams) 2) feature-preview (PMs experimenting with latency/cost control). different onboarding docs + survey for each lane.
carlos.cs: for incentives: 3 months support credit + weekly office hours. also propose a signed "pilot handshake" doc to set expectations on data, SLOs, and success metrics.
maya.pm: agreed. propose success criteria bucketed into "adoption" and "quality":
- adoption: 70% of enrolled complete full setup within 10 business days
- traffic: at least 1k inference requests / customer over pilot period
- quality: no more than 2 regressions vs baseline evals per customer
- ops: no customer experiences >500ms tail latency violation more than twice/week
sam.sre: that latency metric needs a bit more context (seq len, model). can we define a short telemetry schema? cpu/gpu, seq_p50/p95/p99, kv-cache-hits, batching-rate, model-variant
maya.pm: I'll draft schema. for outreach channel: solutions-eng outreach + partner success + one internal BD contact per customer.
ethan.eng: for onboarding checklist (automation we can ship):
```
- precheck: VPN / VPC peering validated
- creds: KMS key + service account created
- network: route tables + egress rules approved
- test: run smoke request with sample model and verify response and kv-cache behavior
- telemetry: fluentd agent pushed, metrics visible in console
```
lena.design: add a short guided walkthrough doc (5 steps) and an embedded feedback form right after step 3 so we collect first-time friction points.
carlos.cs: feedback loop cadence:
- weekly 30m office hours
- bi-weekly 1:1 deep dive with top 3 customers
- post-setup survey at day 3 + day 21 NPS-style
- automated evals against our canary prompt set every 48h
beta-bot: Form created: https://forms.redwood.ai/pilot-onboard (created by beta-bot)
maya.pm: Nice — next up: scoring rubric for candidate prioritization. proposed fields: integration complexity (low/med/high), business impact (1-5), security posture (ok/needs work), availability of eng contact (yes/no). weighted score to pick top 10.
ethan.eng: add "expected seq length" and "peak qps" to prioritize infra stressers.
sam.sre: also tag customers with region preference so we can test routing/fallback. don't overload a single datacenter.
lena.design: experiment with two different feedback forms — short (3 q) for busy teams, long (10 q) for power users. track completion rates per lane.
maya.pm: timeline proposal: outreach week 0, onboarding week 1-2, stabilization week 3-6, feedback wrap week 7. decision gate at week 6: if >=3 customers meet success metrics, scale pilot.
carlos.cs: legal asks: minimal pilot contract + DPA excerpt. I'll loop in legal template.
ethan.eng: engineering deliverables for pilot branch:
- onboarding automation script
- telemetry schema + dashboard tiles
- auto-fallback policy (model variant + region) with canary toggle
- runbook for tail-latency incidents
maya.pm: risk register quick notes: 1) onboarding friction 2) silent failures in private routing 3) tokenized billing mismatch. mitigation: precheck automation, end-to-end smoke tests, billing dry-run.
lena.design: need microcopy for handshake doc: clear start/end dates, support window, data retention, rollback clause. I'll draft.
maya.pm: action items — ethan to own automation + telemetry (ETA 10d), carlos owns outreach + legal template (ETA 5d), lena drafts handshake + forms (ETA 3d), sam reviews SRE runbook (ETA 7d). i'll assemble pilot packet.
ethan.eng: ack. will add an initial PR with the onboarding script and telemetry proto.
carlos.cs: starting outreach list — 18 customers shortlisted. i'll do a trimming call with maya tomorrow.
maya.pm: perfect. one more: let's record a 10min onboarding screencast for customers to reduce first-call time.
lena.design: i'll produce the script and record with solutions-eng.
maya.pm: thanks team :thumbsup: we'll reconvene Friday to review packet and outreach copy.
